name: Experiment board — five ways of picking
notes: Five ways of picking bets, each tracked on its own at $100 flat. None is proven. The record decides.

Records are cumulative from Nov 12, 2026. Phase 1 (Nov 12-18) is archived in How It Works — nothing is erased. Nov 19 brought rule changes (value floors, NHL dropped from Biggest Edge, two cards shelved), not a reset. Nov 20 shelved Biggest Edge (now Biggest Disagreement) and renamed the cards in plain language.
More Plays (shelved Nov 18), NBA Assists and Assists + Rebounds (shelved Nov 19), and Biggest Disagreement (shelved Nov 20) keep grading silently; their records are in the shelved list.

shelved.description: Under bets on NBA assists where our number beats the book by more than 2 points. Up to 5 a day, one pick per game.
shelved.name: NBA Assists Card
shelved.shelved_reason: Shelved Nov 19 at 12-21, -$973.31 (ROI -29.5%, n=33). The edge-filtered backtest did not reproduce live. It keeps grading silently as the benchmark.

shelved.description: A wider net: the 10 best picks per sport, with the best 30 shown here, across every sport we cover.
shelved.name: More Plays
shelved.shelved_reason: Shelved Nov 18 at 124-95, -$2,395.58 (ROI -10.9%, n=219). It kept grading silently to a final 144-102, -$1,995.19 (ROI -8.1%, n=246).

shelved.description: Under bets on NBA assists and rebounds, ranked by edge, only from the two pick types that passed our gate. Up to 5 a day, one per game.
shelved.name: Assists + Rebounds Card
shelved.shelved_reason: Shelved Nov 19 at 12-17, -$676.45 (ROI -23.3%, n=29). It keeps grading silently as the benchmark.

shelved.description: Model A's best disagreements with the market: NBA favorites, NBA underdog fades, and WTA tennis, where its number beats the market by 3 cents or more. NHL gold was dropped from the card Nov 19, 2026 after going 2-9 live.
shelved.name: Biggest Disagreement
shelved.shelved_reason: Shelved Nov 20 at 11-14, -$820.80 (ROI -32.8%, n=25) — the only live card whose ROI confidence interval excluded zero. Tightening did not rescue it (the 5-cent-plus bucket was worse, -46.0%). It keeps grading silently as the benchmark. Gold fades continue as a Best Findings and bot component — a different bet, still testing.
